snippet.title: Target One - Battle Royale | Official Gameplay Trailer | Free-to-Play on Steam
snippet.description:
126 players. One island. Be the last one.
 
Target One - Battle Royale is an upcoming free-to-play battle royale for PC. Skydive from the sky, pull your chute, loot fast and fight your way through cities, towns and an airfield while the gas closes in. Play Solo, Duos or Fours, and climb the Top-10 ranked ladder.

🎯 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5460800/

🌐 Official website: https://t1br.com
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/t1br

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT'S IN THE GAME
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
▸ 126-player matches on one large, road-connected island
▸ Solo, Duos and Fours
▸ Skydive and parachute anywhere on the map
▸ Realistic gunplay with scopes, rifles, shotguns and snipers
▸ Drivable vehicles: pickups, muscle cars and quads
▸ Loot in every house, shop and warehouse
▸ Airdrops, gas circles and tight final fights
▸ Ranked Top-10 system with bear rank badges, from Iron Cub to Apex Bear
▸ Skins, crates and a full locker of outfits
▸ Free-to-play

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMING SOON TO STEAM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Wishlist and follow the game on Steam to get notified at launch, and join our Discord for news, playtests and giveaways.

Developed and published by Target One Studios.

#TargetOne #BattleRoyale #T1BR #FreeToPlay #IndieGame #PCGaming #Steam #Gameplay #Trailer #NewGame
